turns.content: Yaar meri shaadi mein six weeks bache hain. Rohan ko haldi mein hona hai, toast bhi dena hai — first year college se mera bhai hai. Par jab bhi Bangalore se travel ki baat karta hoon, bas "dekhte hain yaar, pakka try karunga." Main khud hi uski flight book kar doon kya, khatam jhanjhat?

Samajh sakta hoon ye tension - haldi ke pehle sab confirm karna chahte ho, especially jab bhai first year se hai aur toast dena hai.

Par ek second ruk. "Dekhte hain, try karunga" - ye actually excuse nahi lag raha, genuine confusion ho sakta hai (college schedule, exams, permission). Flight book karne se pehle ek baar directly pooch lo - "sach batao, koi problem hai kya aane mein? Money, college, kuch bhi?" Kabhi kabhi bhai log embarrassed hote hain apni situation share karne mein, especially paisa involved ho.

Agar usne clearly haan bola ke aana hai bas planning ka issue hai, toh flight book karna sahi move hai - especially agar tickets expensive ho rahi hain waqt ke saath. Bas usko pehle inform kar dena "main book kar raha hoon, tu bata konsi date best rahegi" - taaki uske upar surprise na ho aur wo involved feel kare, controlled nahi.

Genuine hesitation hai ya sach mein "dekhte hain" wala casual attitude?

Maine check kiya, nau hazaar ki return flight hai, koi bada amount nahi. Usne do mahine pehle job switch kiya, koi startup hai. Aur aajkal uske replies bhi two-word aate hain, pehle voice notes bhejta tha. Bol raha hoon khud ko ki busy hoga, par hafton se yahi chal raha hai.

Ye pattern change important hai yaar - voice notes se two-word replies, wo sirf "busy" nahi hota, kuch to change hua hai. New startup job mein pressure bahut hota hai, especially shuru ke mahine - imposter syndrome, long hours, ya phir wahan kuch chal nahi raha jaise expect kiya tha.

Flight ka issue chhod, mujhe lagta hai real concern ye hai ki bhai thoda withdraw ho gaya hai. Wo "dekhte hain" bhi isi wajah se ho sakta hai - stress mein future planning ka bandwidth hi nahi bacha hoga.

Ek kaam karo - flight book karne se pehle usko call kar lo, text nahi. Poocho seedha "sab theek hai? Job kaisi ja rahi hai, tu thoda quiet lag raha hai aajkal." Shaadi ki baat baad mein aayegi khudi. Pehle pata karo wo hai kaisa.

Agar sach mein sab fine hai aur bas naye job ki hustle hai, tab flight book kar dena, usse ek weight kam ho jayegi uske upar. Par pehle uske sar pe haath rakhna zaroori hai, flight pe nahi.

Sach bolun toh ab bura lagne laga hai. Agar sach mein care karta toh pehle din haan bol deta na? Soch raha hoon aaj raat call karke seedha puchh loon — "bhai aa raha hai ya nahi, haan ya na." Kam se kam pata toh chalega main kahan khada hoon.

Samajh sakta hoon ye hurt kyun ho raha hai - apni shaadi hai, bhai ka toast chahiye, aur uncertainty mein rehna sabse mushkil hota hai.

Par ek baat sochna - "haan ya na" wala ultimatum tone agar frustration se aaya, toh wo defensive ho jayega, aur jo actually chal raha hai uske sar mein (job stress, kuch aur), wo bahar nahi aayega. Tumhe answer mil jayega par relationship mein distance aa jayega, jo abhi already thoda hai two-word replies ki wajah se.

Try ye karo - call karo, par pehle uske baare mein pooch lo, phir apni baat rakho honestly. Kuch aisa:

"Yaar, kal se sochta reh gaya - tu kaisa hai actually? Naya job, sab theek chal raha hai?" ... sunna uska jawab dhyan se ...

Phir: "Dekh, main tujhse seedha bolna chahta hoon - meri shaadi hai, tera toast, haldi, sab important hai mere liye. Flight sasti hai, main book kar sakta hoon abhi. Bas mujhe pata chalna chahiye tu aa sakta hai ya nahi, taaki main plan kar sakoon. Koi judgement nahi, bas clarity chahiye."

Ye "haan ya na" hi hai but hurt se nahi, love se aaya hua. Farak wahi decide karega ki conversation kaisi jaati hai.

Meri fiancée bol rahi hai main overthink kar raha hoon, woh bas busy hoga. Par yeh wahi banda hai jo 2019 mein meri behen ki shaadi ke liye overnight bus se aaya tha. Kuch toh badla hai aur samajh nahi aa raha kya, aur haldi se do hafte pehle main usse naraaz baitha hoon, yeh feeling hi ganda hai.

Ye feeling bilkul valid hai - tum apne bhai ko jaante ho, uski fiancée nahi jaanti wo overnight bus wala banda tha. Tumhara instinct usually sahi hota hai jab pattern change dikhta hai, especially jab tumhe uska baseline pata hai.

Aur ye jo naraazi ka feeling hai - usme guilt bhi mixed hai na? Ki main apni shaadi ke stress mein hoon aur shayad bhai kisi mushkil mein hai aur main usse naraaz baitha hoon. Ye combo bahut heavy hota hai.

Ek baat clear kar do apne mann mein - tumhara anger actually love hai jo expression nahi mil raha. Tum darr rahe ho ki kahin wo distant ho gaya, ya kuch chhup rahi hai usne.

Aaj raat wo call karo. Anger se nahi, uss darr se baat karo jo neeche hai. Kuch bhi nikle - job stress ho, ya koi personal cheez, ya genuinely bas busy ho - kam se kam tumhe pata chalega. Aur agar usne kuch chhupaya hai, wo tumhara call hi hoga jo usko batayega ki tum available ho, judge nahi karoge.

Shaadi ke stress mein bhai ko kho dena sabse ganda feeling hoga - ussey pehle try kar lo.
